chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever is pleased that the goodness of his house should increase, then let him perform wudu (ablution) when his food is brought."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How can wudu (ablution) before food increase the blessing of the home?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette of eating connected to taharah (ritual purity) and blessing in the home. It encourages performing wudu (ablution) at the time of الطعام as a means for increasing the good and blessing of one’s household.
